basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer based in Stockholm, Sweden. I've been a Spikeball enthusiast for the past decade and love sharing insights on niche sports. When I'm not working or playing Spikeball, I enjoy exploring the Scandinavian wilderness and diving deep into tech debates, especially those about Apple's ecosystem. I'm married, and my spouse and I often travel across Europe, combining work and leisure. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings, often after 9 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from Lund University and have been working in the software industry for over 12 years. My interest in Spikeball started as a casual hobby but grew through participating in local tournaments and online forums. My tech knowledge is primarily self-taught, supplemented with courses and continuous learning through forums like SonoSequencr.
